                                    282
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    283
                                    
         * @notice Begin application for a round if eligible. Commit a hashed value for which the pre-image will be
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    284
                                    
         * subsequently revealed.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    285
                                    
         * @dev If a node's overlay is _inProximity_(_depth_) of the _currentRoundAnchor_, that node may compute an
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    286
                                    
         * _obfuscatedHash_ by providing their _overlay_, reported storage _depth_, reserve commitment _hash_ and a
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    287
                                    
         * randomly generated, and secret _revealNonce_ to the _wrapCommit_ method.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    288
                                    
         * @param _obfuscatedHash The calculated hash resultant of the required pre-image values.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    289
                                    
         * and be derived from the same key pair as the message sender.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    290
                                    
         * @param _roundNumber Node needs to provide round number for which commit is valid
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    291
                                    
         */
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    292
                                    
        function commit(bytes32 _obfuscatedHash, uint64 _roundNumber) external whenNotPaused {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    293
                                    
            uint64 cr = currentRound();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    294
                                    
            bytes32 _overlay = Stakes.overlayOfAddress(msg.sender);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    295
                                    
            uint256 _stake = Stakes.nodeEffectiveStake(msg.sender);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    296
                                    
            uint256 _lastUpdate = Stakes.lastUpdatedBlockNumberOfAddress(msg.sender);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    297
                                    
            uint8 _height = Stakes.heightOfAddress(msg.sender);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    298
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    299
                                    
            if (_lastUpdate == 0) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    300
                                    
                revert NotStaked();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    301
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    302
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    303
                                    
            if (_lastUpdate >= block.number - 2 * ROUND_LENGTH) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    304
                                    
                revert MustStake2Rounds();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    305
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    306
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    307
                                    
            if (cr > _roundNumber) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    308
                                    
                revert CommitRoundOver();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    309
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    310
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    311
                                    
            if (cr < _roundNumber) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    312
                                    
                revert CommitRoundNotStarted();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    313
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    314
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    315
                                    
            if (!currentPhaseCommit()) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    316
                                    
                revert NotCommitPhase();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    317
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    318
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    319
                                    
            if (block.number % ROUND_LENGTH == (ROUND_LENGTH / 4) - 1) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    320
                                    
                revert PhaseLastBlock();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    321
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    322
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    323
                                    
            // if we are in a new commit phase, reset the array of commits and
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    324
                                    
            // set the currentCommitRound to be the current one
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    325
                                    
            if (cr != currentCommitRound) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    326
                                    
                delete currentCommits;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    327
                                    
                currentCommitRound = cr;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    328
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    329
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    330
                                    
            uint256 commitsArrayLength = currentCommits.length;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    331
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    332
                                    
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < commitsArrayLength; ) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    333
                                    
                if (currentCommits[i].overlay == _overlay) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    334
                                    
                    revert AlreadyCommitted();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    335
                                    
                }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    336
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    337
                                    
                unchecked {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    338
                                    
                    ++i;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    339
                                    
                }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    340
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    341
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    342
                                    
            currentCommits.push(
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    343
                                    
                Commit({
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    344
                                    
                    overlay: _overlay,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    345
                                    
                    owner: msg.sender,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    346
                                    
                    revealed: false,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    347
                                    
                    height: _height,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    348
                                    
                    stake: _stake,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    349
                                    
                    obfuscatedHash: _obfuscatedHash,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    350
                                    
                    revealIndex: 0
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    351
                                    
                })
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    352
                                    
            );
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    353
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    354
                                    
            emit Committed(_roundNumber, _overlay, _height);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    355
                                    
        }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    356
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    357
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    358
                                    
         * @notice Reveal the pre-image values used to generate commit provided during this round's commit phase.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    359
                                    
         * @param _depth The reported depth.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    360
                                    
         * @param _hash The reserve commitment hash.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    361
                                    
         * @param _revealNonce The nonce used to generate the commit that is being revealed.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    362
                                    
         */
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    363
                                    
        function reveal(uint8 _depth, bytes32 _hash, bytes32 _revealNonce) external whenNotPaused {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    364
                                    
            uint64 cr = currentRound();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    365
                                    
            bytes32 _overlay = Stakes.overlayOfAddress(msg.sender);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    366
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    367
                                    
            if (cr != currentCommitRound) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    368
                                    
                revert NoCommitsReceived();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    369
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    370
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    371
                                    
            if (!currentPhaseReveal()) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    372
                                    
                revert NotRevealPhase();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    373
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    374
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    375
                                    
            if (_depth < currentMinimumDepth()) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    376
                                    
                revert OutOfDepth();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    377
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    378
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    379
                                    
            if (cr != currentRevealRound) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    380
                                    
                currentRevealRoundAnchor = currentRoundAnchor();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    381
                                    
                delete currentReveals;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    382
                                    
                // We set currentRevealRound ONLY after we set current anchor
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    383
                                    
                currentRevealRound = cr;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    384
                                    
                emit CurrentRevealAnchor(cr, currentRevealRoundAnchor);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    385
                                    
                updateRandomness();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    386
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    387
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    388
                                    
            bytes32 obfuscatedHash = wrapCommit(_overlay, _depth, _hash, _revealNonce);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    389
                                    
            uint256 id = findCommit(_overlay, obfuscatedHash);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    390
                                    
            Commit memory revealedCommit = currentCommits[id];
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    391
                                    
            uint8 depthResponsibility = _depth - revealedCommit.height;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    392
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    393
                                    
            // Check that commit is in proximity of the current anchor
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    394
                                    
            if (!inProximity(revealedCommit.overlay, currentRevealRoundAnchor, depthResponsibility)) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    395
                                    
                revert OutOfDepthReveal(currentRevealRoundAnchor);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    396
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    397
                                    
            // Check that the commit has not already been revealed
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    398
                                    
            if (revealedCommit.revealed) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    399
                                    
                revert AlreadyRevealed();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    400
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    401
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    402
                                    
            currentCommits[id].revealed = true;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    403
                                    
            currentCommits[id].revealIndex = currentReveals.length;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    404

                                    37

        // Role allowed to freeze and slash entries

        bytes32 public constant REDISTRIBUTOR_ROLE = keccak256("REDISTRIBUTOR_ROLE");
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    40

        // Swarm network ID

        uint64 NetworkId;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    43
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    44
                                    
        // The miniumum stake allowed to be staked using the Staking contract.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    45
                                    
        uint64 private constant MIN_STAKE = 100000000000000000;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    46
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    47
                                    
        // Address of the staked ERC20 token
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    48
                                    
        address public immutable bzzToken;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    49
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    50
                                    
        // The address of the linked PriceOracle contract.

                                    52

        /**

                                    86
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    87
                                    
        // ----------------------------- Errors ------------------------------
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    88
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    89
                                    
        error TransferFailed(); // Used when token transfers fail

                                    95

                                    96
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    97
                                    
        // ----------------------------- CONSTRUCTOR ------------------------------
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    98
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    99
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    100
                                    
         * @param _bzzToken Address of the staked ERC20 token
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    101

                                    102

                                    103
                                    
        constructor(address _bzzToken, uint64 _NetworkId, address _oracleContract) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    104
                                    
            NetworkId = _NetworkId;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    105
                                    
            bzzToken = _bzzToken;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    106
                                    
            OracleContract = IPriceOracle(_oracleContract);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    107

                                    109
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    110
                                    
        ////////////////////////////////////////
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    111
                                    
        //            STATE SETTING           //
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    112
                                    
        ////////////////////////////////////////
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    113
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    114
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    115
                                    
         * @notice Create a new stake or update an existing one, change overlay of node
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    116
                                    
         * @dev At least `_initialBalancePerChunk*2^depth` number of tokens need to be preapproved for this contract.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    117
                                    
         * @param _setNonce Nonce that was used for overlay calculation.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    118
                                    
         * @param _addAmount Deposited amount of ERC20 tokens, equals to added Potential stake value
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    119
                                    
         * @param _height increased reserve by registering the number of doublings
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    120
                                    
         */
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    121
                                    
        function manageStake(bytes32 _setNonce, uint256 _addAmount, uint8 _height) external whenNotPaused {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    122
                                    
            bytes32 _previousOverlay = stakes[msg.sender].overlay;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    123
                                    
            uint256 _stakingSet = stakes[msg.sender].lastUpdatedBlockNumber;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    124
                                    
            bytes32 _newOverlay = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, reverse(NetworkId), _setNonce));
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    125
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    126
                                    
            // First time adding stake, check the minimum is added, take into account height
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    127
                                    
            if (_addAmount < MIN_STAKE * 2 ** _height && _stakingSet == 0) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    128
                                    
                revert BelowMinimumStake();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    129
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    130
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    131
                                    
            if (_stakingSet != 0 && !addressNotFrozen(msg.sender)) revert Frozen();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    132
                                    
            // Set current values, used also when changing overlay
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    133
                                    
            uint256 updatedPotentialStake = stakes[msg.sender].potentialStake;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    134
                                    
            uint256 updatedCommittedStake = stakes[msg.sender].committedStake;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    135
                                    
            uint256 previousCommittedStake = updatedCommittedStake;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    136
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    137
                                    
            // Only update stake values if _addAmount is greater than 0
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    138
                                    
            if (_addAmount > 0) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    139
                                    
                updatedPotentialStake = stakes[msg.sender].potentialStake + _addAmount;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    140
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    141
                                    
                // Calculate new committed stake
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    142
                                    
                uint256 newCommittedStake = updatedPotentialStake / (OracleContract.currentPrice() * 2 ** _height);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    143
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    144
                                    
                // Never allow commitment to decrease
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    145
                                    
                if (newCommittedStake < previousCommittedStake) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    146
                                    
                    revert DecreasedCommitment();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    147
                                    
                }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    148
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    149
                                    
                updatedCommittedStake = newCommittedStake;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    150
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    151
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    152
                                    
            stakes[msg.sender] = Stake({
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    153
                                    
                overlay: _newOverlay,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    154
                                    
                committedStake: updatedCommittedStake,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    155
                                    
                potentialStake: updatedPotentialStake,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    156
                                    
                lastUpdatedBlockNumber: block.number,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    157
                                    
                height: _height
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    158
                                    
            });
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    159
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    160
                                    
            // Transfer tokens and emit event that stake has been updated
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    161
                                    
            if (_addAmount > 0) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    162
                                    
                if (!ERC20(bzzToken).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _addAmount)) revert TransferFailed();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    163
                                    
                emit StakeUpdated(
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    164
                                    
                    msg.sender,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    165
                                    
                    updatedCommittedStake,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    166
                                    
                    updatedPotentialStake,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    167
                                    
                    _newOverlay,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    168
                                    
                    block.number,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    169
                                    
                    _height
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    170
                                    
                );
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    171
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    172
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    173
                                    
            // Emit overlay change event
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    174
                                    
            if (_previousOverlay != _newOverlay) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    175
                                    
                emit OverlayChanged(msg.sender, _newOverlay);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    176
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    177
                                    
        }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    178
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    179
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    180
                                    
         * @dev Withdraw node stake surplus
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    181
                                    
         */
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    182
                                    
        function withdrawFromStake() external {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    183
                                    
            uint256 _potentialStake = stakes[msg.sender].potentialStake;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    184
                                    
            uint256 _surplusStake = _potentialStake -
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    185
                                    
                calculateEffectiveStake(stakes[msg.sender].committedStake, _potentialStake, stakes[msg.sender].height);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    186
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    187
                                    
            if (_surplusStake > 0) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    188
                                    
                stakes[msg.sender].potentialStake -= _surplusStake;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    189
                                    
                if (!ERC20(bzzToken).transfer(msg.sender, _surplusStake)) revert TransferFailed();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    190
                                    
                emit StakeWithdrawn(msg.sender, _surplusStake);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    191
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    192
                                    
        }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    193
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    194
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    195
                                    
         * @dev Migrate stake only when the staking contract is paused,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    196
                                    
         * can only be called by the owner of the stake
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    197
                                    
         */
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    198
                                    
        function migrateStake() external whenPaused {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    199
                                    
            // We take out all the stake so user can migrate stake to other contract
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    200
                                    
            if (lastUpdatedBlockNumberOfAddress(msg.sender) != 0) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    201
                                    
                if (!ERC20(bzzToken).transfer(msg.sender, stakes[msg.sender].potentialStake)) revert TransferFailed();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    202
                                    
                delete stakes[msg.sender];
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    203
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    204
                                    
        }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    205
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    206
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    207
                                    
         * @dev Freeze an existing stake, can only be called by the redistributor
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    208
                                    
         * @param _owner the addres selected
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    209
                                    
         * @param _time penalty length in blocknumbers
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    210
                                    
         */
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    211
                                    
        function freezeDeposit(address _owner, uint256 _time) external {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    212
                                    
            if (!hasRole(REDISTRIBUTOR_ROLE, msg.sender)) revert OnlyRedistributor();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    213
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    214
                                    
            if (stakes[_owner].lastUpdatedBlockNumber != 0) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    215
                                    
                stakes[_owner].lastUpdatedBlockNumber = block.number + _time;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    216
                                    
                emit StakeFrozen(_owner, stakes[_owner].overlay, _time);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    217
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    218
                                    
        }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    219
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    220
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    221
                                    
         * @dev Slash an existing stake, can only be called by the `redistributor`
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    222
                                    
         * @param _owner the _owner adress selected
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    223
                                    
         * @param _amount the amount to be slashed
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    224
                                    
         */
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    225
                                    
        function slashDeposit(address _owner, uint256 _amount) external {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    226
                                    
            if (!hasRole(REDISTRIBUTOR_ROLE, msg.sender)) revert OnlyRedistributor();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    227
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    228
                                    
            if (stakes[_owner].lastUpdatedBlockNumber != 0) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    229
                                    
                if (stakes[_owner].potentialStake > _amount) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    230
                                    
                    stakes[_owner].potentialStake -= _amount;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    231
                                    
                    stakes[_owner].lastUpdatedBlockNumber = block.number;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    232
                                    
                } else {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    233
                                    
                    delete stakes[_owner];
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    234
                                    
                }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    235
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    236
                                    
            emit StakeSlashed(_owner, stakes[_owner].overlay, _amount);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    237
                                    
        }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    238
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    239
                                    
        function changeNetworkId(uint64 _NetworkId) external {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    240
                                    
            if (!hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender)) revert Unauthorized();

                                    242
                                    
        }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    243
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    244
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    245
                                    
         * @dev Pause the contract. The contract is provably stopped by renouncing
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    246
                                    
         the pauser role and the admin role after pausing, can only be called by the `PAUSER`
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    247
                                    
         */
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    248
                                    
        function pause() public {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    249
                                    
            if (!hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender)) revert OnlyPauser();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    250
                                    
            _pause();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    251
                                    
        }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    252
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    253
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    254
                                    
         * @dev Unpause the contract, can only be called by the pauser when paused
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    255
                                    
         */
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    256
                                    
        function unPause() public {

            if (!hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender)) revert OnlyPauser();

                                    259
                                    
        }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    260
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    261
                                    
        ////////////////////////////////////////
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    262
                                    
        //            STATE READING           //
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    263
                                    
        ////////////////////////////////////////
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    264
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    265
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    266
                                    
         * @dev Checks to see if `address` is frozen.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    267
                                    
         * @param _owner owner of staked address
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    268
                                    
         *
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    269
                                    
         * Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    270
                                    
         */
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    271
                                    
        function addressNotFrozen(address _owner) internal view returns (bool) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    272
                                    
            return stakes[_owner].lastUpdatedBlockNumber < block.number;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    273
                                    
        }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    274
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    275
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    276
                                    
         * @dev Returns the current `effectiveStake` of `address`. previously usable stake
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    277
                                    
         * @param _owner _owner of node
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    278
                                    
         */
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    279
                                    
        function nodeEffectiveStake(address _owner) public view returns (uint256) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    280
                                    
            return
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    281
                                    
                addressNotFrozen(_owner)
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    282
                                    
                    ? calculateEffectiveStake(
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    283
                                    
                        stakes[_owner].committedStake,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    284
                                    
                        stakes[_owner].potentialStake,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    285
                                    
                        stakes[_owner].height
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    286
                                    
                    )
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    287
                                    
                    : 0;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    288
                                    
        }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    289
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    290
                                    
        /**
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    291
                                    
         * @dev Check the amount that is possible to withdraw as surplus
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    292
                                    
         */
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    293

            // Wire roles: redistribution must be able to freeze stake and withdraw the stamp pot.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    128
                                    
            stake.grantRole(stake.REDISTRIBUTOR_ROLE(), address(redist));
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    129
                                    
            stamp.grantRole(stamp.REDISTRIBUTOR_ROLE(), address(redist));
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    130
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    131
                                    
            // Create actor contracts and pre-fund + pre-stake them.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    132
                                    
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < ACTOR_COUNT; i++) {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    133
                                    
                actors[i] = new EchidnaSystemActor(token, stake, stamp, oracle, redist);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    134
                                    
                bootstrapNonce[i] = keccak256(abi.encodePacked("bootstrap", i));
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    135
                                    
                // Mint enough for both staking and postage operations.

                                    139
                                    
            }
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    140
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    141
                                    
            // Create a dedicated price updater (actor[0]) for adjustPrice.
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    142
                                    
            oracle.grantRole(oracle.PRICE_UPDATER_ROLE(), address(actors[0]));
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    143
                                    
        }

        function act_actor_createBatch(
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    166
                                    
            uint8 actorId,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    167
                                    
            uint256 initialBalancePerChunk,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    168

                                    169
                                    
            uint8 bucketDepth,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    170
                                    
            bytes32 nonce,
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    171
                                    
            bool imm
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    172
                                    
        ) external {
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    173
                                    
            EchidnaSystemActor a = actors[uint256(actorId) % ACTOR_COUNT];
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    174
                                    
            uint8 minBucket = stamp.minimumBucketDepth();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    175
                                    
            // depth must exceed minimumBucketDepth; allow [minBucket+1 .. minBucket+10]
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    176
                                    
            uint8 d = uint8(minBucket + 1 + (depth % 10));
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    177
                                    
            // bucketDepth must be in [minBucket, d-1]
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    178
                                    
            uint8 b = uint8(minBucket + (bucketDepth % (d - minBucket)));
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    179
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    180
                                    
            uint256 min = stamp.minimumInitialBalancePerChunk();
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    181
                                    
            uint256 init = initialBalancePerChunk % (min + 1e6);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    182
                                    
            if (init < min) init = min;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    183
                                    
            if (init == 0) init = 1;
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    184
                                    
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    185
                                    
            a.callCreateBatch(address(a), init, d, b, nonce, imm);
    		
                                
    
                                
    
                                    186
                                    
        }
